content:
The image shows a mango leaf with irregular dark brown/black spots scattered across the upper surface. The spots are sunken-looking, dark, and irregularly shaped — consistent with anthracnose lesions on leaves.

Key observations:
- Irregular, dark brown to black lesions on the leaf surface
- Spots are scattered across the leaf (not confined to margins or underside)
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty encrustation covering the surface (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No bark discoloration, gum secretion, or twig withering (rules out Die Back)
- The lesion pattern matches anthracnose: irregular, oval/angular dark spots on leaves
